# Brief: a small review tool

The reviewer runs `claude plugin validate .` and passes `--json-schema` so the answer is typed.
It must never pass `--max-turns`.
Rows land under `~/.code-forge/ledger` and the type checker reads `@types/node`.
Answers go to https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone and the tool honours DO_NOT_TRACK.
